facts.fact: D-Bus interface org.bootcontrol.Manager exposes about 30 async methods; GRUB-related ones are ReadGrubConfig, ReadGrubSettings, SetGrubSettings, SetGrubValue, SetGrubDefault, GetEtag, ListGrubEntries and RebuildGrubConfig. Read methods take no authorization.

Write methods resolve caller UID via GetConnectionUnixUser, call authorize with REWRITE_GRUB using the sender bus name, then require_writable_host. The UID is used only for audit and snapshot metadata, not for the Polkit subject.

authorize_with_polkit validates action against KNOWN_ACTIONS then, under polkit-mock feature, returns Ok for any caller; otherwise calls CheckAuthorization with a system-bus-name subject and AllowUserInteraction.

SetGrubValue accepts caller-chosen key, value and etag strings. Only sanitize::check_payload (substring blacklist re-exported from core security) screens them before they reach the file rewrite; no key-name allowlist or character-class restriction is visible in the daemon layer.

set_grub_values_with_prewrite opens the config, flocks non-blocking, reads via locked fd, verifies etag, parses with parse_grub_config, replaces the last matching KEY= line or appends, then writes a sibling .bootcontrol.tmp and renames over the target.

build_assignment_line wraps value in double quotes only if it contains space, tab or is empty; otherwise writes KEY=value verbatim. No escaping of quotes, newlines, dollar, backtick or semicolons occurs at this layer; is_assignment_for_key matches on trimmed KEY= prefix.

write_file_atomically uses File::create on the predictable path <target>.bootcontrol.tmp in the target's directory, without O_EXCL, explicit mode, or symlink checks; mode of the original is captured only for snapshot metadata.

run_grub_mkconfig resolves grub-mkconfig or grub2-mkconfig via which on inherited PATH and runs it with -o <output_path>; the child inherits the daemon environment. Called after every successful GRUB write and by RebuildGrubConfig directly.
grub-mkconfig stderr is embedded whole into the EspScanFailed reason returned over D-Bus, and audit Completed events store the error string as stderr_tail.

SetGrubDefault reads the generated grub.cfg under the config lock, checks menu_etag, requires selected_path to match a non-submenu entry, then writes GRUB_DEFAULT via the generic path; selected_path is also passed through check_payload.

Daemon parses /etc/default/grub (parse_grub_config bails on complex bash constructs) and /boot/grub/grub.cfg (parse_menu_entries) for unauthenticated read methods; the parsed grub.cfg titles and ids are serialized to JSON for clients.

main.rs honors BOOTCONTROL_BUS, BOOTCONTROL_GRUB_PATH, BOOTCONTROL_FAILSAFE_PATH, BOOTCONTROL_SNAPSHOT_ROOT, BOOTCONTROL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS, and under polkit-mock plus session bus BOOTCONTROL_UKI_DIR and BOOTCONTROL_ENTRY_TOKEN_PATH to override managed paths and UKI policy.
Each GRUB write snapshots locked bytes under snapshot_root before mutation; RestoreSnapshot is contained to managed_paths derived from configured paths, which are env-overridable at startup.

Beyond GRUB, the interface writes systemd-boot loader entries, kernel cmdline params, EFI boot order and BootNext, NVRAM backups, and signs UKIs; these are separate sinks sharing the same authorization helper pattern.

gaps: interface.rs lines 1356-2260 (NVRAM, UKI signing, loader, cmdline, snapshot restore, EFI boot order methods) were inventoried by signature only, not read in full
core grub.rs parser and security.rs blacklist bodies not fully read; whether newline or quote characters in values are rejected before write is unverified
packaging D-Bus policy, polkit policy and systemd unit hardening not read
failsafe.rs and snapshot.rs write paths not read
CI workflows and Cargo feature gating of polkit-mock in release packaging not inspected
